lines.text: which guides everything for the best even when we ourselves
do not know what the best for us is.
By this means our life gains clarity and peace. This does
not mean that in the ground plan of our life, in its purposes
and aims, we embody an intelligent solution to the riddle
of existence. Every question which is aimed at mastering the
secret pattern of existence must in fact be silenced; and we
remain ignorant of the goal to which God is leading us. No,
our life gains clarity only because everything He sends us we
may and must receive as the gift of His love:
"Let His loving glance deeply penetrate your soul, and
His eternal light and joy will flood your being. Heart and
mind and spirit shall then awaken to new life."
Luminous transparency must also penetrate our life in so
far as it is a life of responsibility and action. We do not
suggest that the Christian should be able to organize his life
in accordance with a completely clear plan. The clarity
which the divine light gives is not the clarity of a pro-
gramme, but the clarity which flows from the awareness of
being sustained by the divine love which frees us for the
manifestation of love in our own lives. Our eyes are then
opened to the truth that we ourselves can and must be
bearers of divine light and love in the world; that the
decisions with which each day and moment face us should
be made in the spirit of love; that the plans and the projects
which our responsibilities in daily life constantly demand
from us, should be conceived in the spirit of love. We are
able to see how much others need us and where and how we
can help them. Thus our life becomes filled with a new
radiance and transparency; thus our true self finds its fulfil-
ment, if we no longer will to live for ourselves and by our
own resources, but in the light of the love of God and in the
service of others.
"Divinity, of which man has so often been afraid, has now
been imparted to us. In the south and the north, it has
awakened to life seeds of eternity. Let us then, in the richly
dowered garden of God, faithfully await the blooming of
each bud and blossom."
